certifiedResults.metadataNotes: Parsed from the Nevada Secretary of State 2024 Official Statewide General Election Results page. The archived official snapshot includes the President and Vice President of the United States table with county columns and reconciles to statewide candidate totals.

reviewCharts.presidentContest: President and Vice President of the United States

turnout.sourceTitle: Nevada Secretary of State 2024 election cycle turnout highlights
turnout.notes: Statewide turnout is loaded from the Nevada Secretary of State post-certification election-cycle highlights. Rows are warning-labeled because this source does not provide county turnout rows in the captured app data.

certifiedResults.title: Nevada official presidential county results
certifiedResults.detail: County-level presidential results are parsed from the Nevada Secretary of State 2024 Official Statewide General Election Results table. The live SOS page is protected from plain HTTP collection in this environment, so the build uses an archived official snapshot of the same page.
certifiedResults.sourceTimestampBasis: Wayback capture of Nevada Secretary of State official statewide general election results page; page heading says 2024 Official Statewide General Election Results, November 5, 2024.

wardDetail.title: Nevada county review comparison
wardDetail.detail: County-level review rows compare the official Nevada presidential table to the official U.S. Senate table from the same SOS statewide results page. Precinct or reporting-unit review remains a follow-up if a lower-level official source is collected.
wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: Official SOS table checked during Nevada promotion; it provides county columns but not precinct rows.

turnout.title: Nevada statewide turnout
turnout.detail: Statewide turnout is loaded from the Nevada Secretary of State post-certification election-cycle highlights: 2,042,607 active registered voters and 1,487,887 voters who cast a ballot. County turnout rows remain blocked behind the protected SOS turnout-reporting page.
turnout.sourceTimestampBasis: Official SOS post-certification news item dated November 19, 2024.

checkedNotUsable.nextStep: Refresh from the live SOS page if browser-backed collection is added to the source pipeline.
